caption:
Chip stocks crashed 12.25% on Nov 5, their biggest one-day drop since March 2020, and have lost about $3.7 trillion in value since early October. Memory got hit hardest: SanDisk fell 22%, Micron 17.5%. Tonight at 5pm ET, Nvidia reports its quarter.

Get this week's five, free every Saturday → link in bio.

#semiconductors #chipstocks #NVDA #Micron #AMD

Sources: IBTimes (Nov 6, 2026), Heygotrade citing Yahoo Finance and Investing.com (Nov 2026), Nvidia (earnings call, Nov 17, 2026). Not investment advice.
